visualCharacteristics.structure: heading + intro, room tabs (icon + name), 3:2 stage (base photo, one masked paint layer per surface, shading overlay), surface buttons, instruction, palette chips, selected color + Add to project / Clear colors pills
visualCharacteristics.layout: stacked on mobile; desktop 2 columns: intro + selection panel left, tabs/stage/chips right

contentPattern: 4 columns. Text rows: [h2], [intro text], [instruction text]. Room rows (picture in cell 2): [:icon-name: + room name | base picture | ul > li (p surface name, p mask picture with alpha) | shading/gel picture]. Color row: [ul > li > a text="CODE|Name|HEX" palette | ul with the default color link | | ].
